latestVersion.changelog:
Clipchamp 1.0.0 — AI-Powered Fast Video Editing

- Instantly edit and export video clips (screen recordings, phone footage, etc.) to polished 1080p videos by simply describing your needs—no manual timeline work or export settings.
- Fully automates session creation, anonymous token handling, and initialization; just upload your clip and get started.
- Supports fast, cloud GPU editing and export in common formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac) with typical job completion in 1-2 minutes for short (~2 min) clips.
- Seamlessly handles common requests like upload, export, checking credits, and session state via keyword classification.
- Includes detailed error handling (token expiry, session loss, unsupported file/size, rate limits) and user-friendly feedback throughout the workflow.
- Provides clear tips, workflows, and best practices for content creators and marketers looking to turn raw clips into social-ready exports in minutes.
